name: Turkish Airlines
verdict: Controlled by the Turkish state: its wealth fund owns 49.12% and a state golden share steers the board.
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): the state's wealth fund owns 49.12% and a Treasury golden share carries privileged voting rights over board nominations (control).

why.text: Turkey’s sovereign wealth fund owns 49.12% of Turkish Airlines, and a special share held by the state carries privileged voting rights over who is nominated to the board. Turkey has kept civil society leader Osman Kavala in prison since 2017, and in 2026 the European Court of Human Rights ruled that he was convicted to punish and silence him. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
